import io
import warnings
from unittest import mock

import pytest
from aiohttp import FormData, hdrs


def test_formdata_initial_state() -> None:
    form = FormData()
    assert not form.is_multipart
    assert form._fields == []


def test_formdata_add_field_with_bytes() -> None:
    form = FormData()
    form.add_field("test", b"test")
    assert form.is_multipart


def test_formdata_add_field_with_bytearray() -> None:
    form = FormData()
    form.add_field("test", bytearray(b"test"))
    assert form.is_multipart


def test_formdata_add_field_with_memoryview() -> None:
    form = FormData()
    form.add_field("test", memoryview(b"test"))
    assert form.is_multipart


def test_formdata_add_field_with_file_object() -> None:
    form = FormData()
    form.add_field("test", io.BytesIO(b"test"))
    assert form.is_multipart

    form = FormData()
    form.add_field("test", b"test", filename="test.txt")

    form.add_field("test", b"test", content_type="text/plain")

import asyncio
import zlib
from typing import Any, Optional, Union
from aiohttp import ClientConnectionResetError
from aiohttp.http_websocket import WebSocketWriter, WSMsgType
from tests.test_benchmarks_http_websocket import MockTransport, MockProtocol

def test_send_frame_with_closing_transport(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    writer._closing = True
    with pytest.raises(ClientConnectionResetError, match="Cannot write to closing transport"):
        loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(b"message", WSMsgType.TEXT))

def test_send_frame_with_large_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    large_message = b"a" * 65536
    loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(large_message, WSMsgType.TEXT))

def test_send_frame_with_compression(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport(), compress=9)
    message = b"Hello, World!"
    loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(message, WSMsgType.TEXT))

def test_send_frame_with_mask(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport(), use_mask=True)
    message = b"Hello, World!"
    loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(message, WSMsgType.TEXT))

def test_send_frame_with_invalid_opcode(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid opcode"):
        loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(b"message", 10))

def test_send_frame_with_drain_helper(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport(), limit=10)
    message = b"a" * 10
    loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(message, WSMsgType.TEXT))
    loop.run_until_complete(writer._send_frame(message, WSMsgType.TEXT))

def test_pong_with_string_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.pong("Hello, World!"))

def test_ping_with_string_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.ping("Hello, World!"))

def test_send_with_string_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.send("Hello, World!"))

def test_send_with_binary_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.send(b"Hello, World!"))

def test_send_with_compression(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport(), compress=9)
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.send("Hello, World!"))

def test_close_with_code_and_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.close(1000, "Goodbye"))

def test_close_with_only_code(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.close(1000))

def test_close_with_only_message(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    loop.run_until_complete(writer.close(message="Goodbye"))

def test_make_compress_obj(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    writer = WebSocketWriter(MockProtocol(loop=loop), MockTransport())
    compress_obj = writer._make_compress_obj(9)
    assert isinstance(compress_obj, zlib.compressobj)
